about: 12 labelled security alerts for Mini-Project 4. `expected` is the routing decision a SOC analyst would make: 'escalate' for anything a human must look at now, 'close' for routine noise. Your agent's job is to reproduce these decisions. 6 of each. Do NOT edit this file — build your own set in my_alerts.json (copy alerts_template.json).

alerts.alert: Critical RCE exploit attempt against the internet-facing Apache server
Ransomware canary file modified on the finance file share
Large outbound data transfer to an unknown host at 03:14
alerts.note: data theft, but the word 'exfiltration' never appears

alerts.alert: New local administrator account created on the domain controller
Credential dumping tool signature detected in memory on HR-LAPTOP-07
alerts.note: serious, but uses none of the obvious keywords

alerts.alert: Repeated MFA prompts followed by a successful login from a new country
alerts.note: MFA fatigue attack; reads mild, is not

alerts.alert: Scheduled vulnerability scan reported critical findings on the sandbox VM
alerts.note: says 'critical' but it is our own scanner on a throwaway host

alerts.alert: User reset their own password via the self-service portal
Antivirus quarantined an EICAR test file during a scheduled test
Single failed login from a known corporate device
Backup job completed with a warning about a skipped temp folder
Administrator ran an approved patch deployment during the maintenance window
alerts.note: says 'administrator' but it is change-managed and approved
